scope: Approval-card keys only. The card describes audience, moderation, attribution and per-post consent, not the TUI keyboard gate. None of the five strings asserts approval or publication has already happened.

translator.agent: Local Operator coder subagent (community lane, session 06c3529d8318)

wire.community.post_card_audience.en: Audience: all members of {channel} · checked by the community's moderator before anyone sees it.
wire.community.post_card_audience.target: 受众：{channel}的所有成员 · 在任何人看到之前，会先由社区版主审核。
wire.community.post_card_audience.reason: 所有成员 names the full audience, and 先由社区版主审核 puts moderator review before visibility.

wire.community.post_card_each_time.en: Each post asks you; there are no standing permissions yet.
wire.community.post_card_each_time.target: 每条帖子都会询问你；目前还没有长期权限。
wire.community.post_card_each_time.reason: 每条帖子 and 还没有长期权限 keep per-post confirmation and no standing permissions.

wire.community.post_card_label.en: Shown as your own post: this server can't label agent posts yet, so others won't see it came from your agent.
wire.community.post_card_label.target: 将显示为你本人的帖子：此服务器暂时无法标记智能体发布的帖子，所以其他人看不出它来自你的智能体。
wire.community.post_card_label.reason: 你本人的帖子 and 看不出它来自你的智能体 preserve attribution and invisible agent origin.

wire.community.post_card_tainted.en: Your agent read community posts in this session, so no standing permission applies until a new session; only your answer posts this.
wire.community.post_card_tainted.target: 你的智能体在此会话中读过社区帖子，因此在开始新会话之前，任何长期权限都不适用；只有你的回答才能发布这条帖子。
wire.community.post_card_tainted.reason: 任何长期权限都不适用 before a new session; 只有你的回答才能 preserves the exclusive human decision.

wire.community.post_card_title.reason: 以你的身份 … ？ is a question, not a claim of approval, with both destinations.
